status: Proposed operations and semantics; not implemented routes or an OpenAPI schema

patient_endpoints.semantics: Read with explicit source scope, cutoff, completeness and mode. No new clinical decision.
May persist proposal/audit; explicit write semantics; no medication order.
Atomic current-context/expected-revision recheck plus durable decision and receipt.
Clinician authority, exact effective range and conflict/expiry checks.
Attributed bedside observation, not remote device operation.
Explicit clinician assertion with certainty and alternatives.
Source/clinical test record and eligibility; no maneuver/ventilator control.
Validated method-specific interpretation; no image diagnosis.
Plan distinct from prescribing and actual MAR/M9 delivery.
Supported profiles only; no start/dose/titration command.
Owned discrepancy resolution; do not overwrite original MAR/pump facts.
Actual bedside assessment; urgent duties retained.
Supported framework/clinician confirmation, no automatic device selection.
Specialty scope and unsupported-profile behavior.
Hemodynamic review only; removal execution stays with M8/M9.
Read-only source device-team/M12 information; no controls.
Exact requested profile and inputs; reject unsupported/missing prerequisites.
Optional persistence; client-session-only mode also permitted; no clinical fact updates.
Append-only actual attempt/content pin/actor; no automatic resolution.
Owned review/communication record; no procedural action or device operation.
Receiving acceptance tracked separately; sending owner persists until accepted.
Exact retained lookup, not clinical recomputation.
Original key/digest; no-row only not_found_yet; terminal no-effect needs fence/proof.

shared_operations: POST operations /recovery (owned idempotent recovery, no guessed patient assignment)

errors.404: Not found/inaccessible without foreign disclosure; receipt absence not no-effect.
errors.422: Requested clinical/number use unsupported/not evaluable; source evidence remains available.
errors.503: Affected service/source unavailable; attempted write completion may be unknown.
